{{Quote|Check it out, boys. Time to watch the Dominoes fall.|CT-66-3233 talking to his squad|<ref name="Clone Cadets">{{TCW|Clone Cadets}}</ref>}}
'''CT-66-3233''' was a [[Clone cadet/Legends|cadet]] and part of [[Bravo Squad (clone cadets)/Legends|Bravo Squad]].

==Biography==
When [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC trooper]] Commander [[Colt/Legends|Colt]] arrived on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to supervise the graduation tests of the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] cadets, Bravo Squad was the first team to take the [[Citadel Challenge/Legends|Citadel Challenge]]. During this challenge, the cadets worked as a team and finished the course in record time, with [[Domino Squad/Legends|Domino Squad]] watching them from above. When it was time for Domino to take the test, this clone mocked them, telling his [[Squad/Legends|squad]] to watch as the team fails.

==Behind the scenes==
This Bravo Squad cadet's identification number was first depicted in the episode "[[Clone Cadets]]" of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''. It says 66-3233, and the prefix CT- was predetermined. This way of determining identification numbers was proved with the troopers in Domino Squad.
